description: Displays an SVG map with region selection, tooltips, panning, and zooming.

props.color: Fallback fill color for shapes without a fill in the SVG. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.disabled: Disables region selection, tooltips, and map navigation.
props.label: Accessible name of the map. Accepts plain text or a locale key.
props.maxZoom: Maximum magnification relative to the complete SVG viewBox.
props.minZoom: Minimum magnification. Values below one are treated as one.
props.modelValue: Selected region identifier, or an array of identifiers when **multiple** is enabled. Activating a selected region deselects it.
props.multiple: Allows selecting more than one region. The model contains an array of region identifiers.
props.pan: Enables dragging within the SVG bounds and moving the viewport to reveal a focused region.
props.readonly: Prevents selection changes while retaining navigation and region events.
props.regionColors: Maps region identifiers to theme colors or CSS fill colors.
props.regionLabels: Maps region identifiers to accessible labels and tooltip text.
props.selectedColor: Fill color of the selected region. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.svg: SVG markup supplied by the application. Parsing runs after mounting in the browser.
props.tooltip: Displays the active region label in a tooltip. A `tooltip` slot also enables tooltips.
props.wheel: Enables zooming with the mouse wheel. Does not affect touch gestures. Modified wheel events retain their browser behavior.
props.zoom: Magnification relative to the complete SVG viewBox. Supports `v-model:zoom`.
props.zoomOnFocus: Fits a keyboard-focused region in the viewport, within the zoom limits. Requires **pan** and **zoomable**. Respects reduced motion preferences.
props.zoomStep: Relative zoom increment used by the mouse wheel, double click, and exposed zoom methods. Also adjusts the sensitivity of continuous pinch zoom.
props.zoomable: Enables double click, pinch gestures, and the exposed zoom methods. Mouse wheel zoom also requires **wheel**.

slots.default: Content inside the map container, outside SVG. Receives the regions, selection, mutable `zoom` ref, zoom limits, and `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, and `reset` functions for custom controls.
slots.error: Content shown when SVG parsing fails. Receives the error.
slots.map: Additional SVG content positioned in the source map coordinate system. Receives the regions, selection, and current viewBox.
slots.tooltip: Custom tooltip content receiving the region identifier, title, and selection state.

events.click:region: Emitted with the region and originating mouse or keyboard event when a region is activated.
events.error: Emitted when parsing the SVG fails.
events.hover:region: Emitted with the active region on pointer hover or keyboard focus, or null when it leaves.
events.load: Emitted with the discovered regions after the current SVG source has been parsed.
events.update:modelValue: Emitted when the selected region changes.
events.update:zoom: Emitted when a navigation action changes magnification.

exposed.reset: Restores centered framing at the minimum zoom.
exposed.zoomIn: Increases zoom around the center of the current view.
exposed.zoomOut: Decreases zoom around the center of the current view.
